findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司為無廠半導體，關稅與貿易限制可能影響客戶需求與供應鏈；美國對半導體相關產品出口中國的管制若擴及公司主力產品/市場，可能衝擊公司。
findings.excerpt: In addition, the U.S. government has implemented controls affecting the ability to send certain products and technology related to semiconductors, semiconductor manufacturing and supercomputing to China without an export license and added additional entities to restricted party lists in addition to other import/export and national security laws and regulations. We may be impacted by any of these current or new restrictions in the future if such controls are expanded to cover our key products/markets.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明貿易行動（美、中、歐等的關稅、報復性關稅）可能使客戶需求下降並間接降低對公司產品需求；公司無法預測政府行動。
findings.excerpt: Government actions that affect our customers’ ability to sell products or access critical elements of their supply chains may result in a decreased demand for their products, which may consequently reduce their demand for our products.

findings.claim: 2026-01-14 總統公告對特定先進半導體產品課 25% Section 232 關稅（範圍窄，依技術參數與用途）；搜尋結果未提 Rambus 是否適用

note: 搜尋未找到 Rambus 專屬的 Section 232 或實體清單事件；2026-01 的 232 半導體關稅（25%，窄範圍先進晶片）搜尋結果未提及 Rambus，不下判斷。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
